title: Warm Water, Clean Towels
paras: Welcome to our small museum in [[england|England]]. This room shows a bath house from 1900. Many homes had no hot water then. People came here for a warm [[bath|bath]] and clean skin. Look at the clock above the door. The house opened at [[nine|nine]] in the morning. It stayed open [[until|until]] six in the evening, so people could come after work.

Follow the blue line to the next room. Here, [[women|women]] washed in small rooms with doors. There were [[twelve|twelve]] rooms in all. A worker put a clean towel in [[each|each]] room. She also brought soap and checked the water. Touch the dry towel on this table. It is a copy, but the big white water jug beside it is old.

Now sit on the wooden seat for a [[moment|moment]]. Listen to a short story about Ada, a worker at the bath house. She liked giving tired visitors a [[feeling|feeling]] of care and comfort. Do you [[want|want]] to see her work bag? It is by the exit. Inside are her lunch box and a small cup. Her day ended with warm tea. Your visit ends here, too.
zh: 欢迎来到我们位于英格兰的小博物馆。这个展厅展示了1900年的一座公共浴室。当时，许多家庭没有热水。人们来这里泡个热水澡，把身体洗干净。请看门上方的时钟。浴室早上九点开门，一直营业到傍晚六点，所以人们下班后也能来。
沿着蓝线走到下一个展厅。在这里，女性在带门的小房间里洗澡。一共有十二间。工作人员会在每个房间里放一条干净毛巾。她还会送来肥皂，检查洗澡水。摸摸这张桌上的干毛巾。它是复制品，但旁边那个白色的大水壶是旧时留下来的。
现在，请在木座椅上坐一会儿，听一个关于浴室工作人员艾达的小故事。她喜欢让疲惫的客人感到受关怀、很舒适。你想看看她上班带的包吗？它就在出口旁边，里面有她的饭盒和一个小杯子。她的一天以喝热茶收尾。你的参观也在这里结束。

q.s: The bath house opened every day.
q.why: 文章给出营业时段，未说明是否每天开放。

q.s: There were ten small rooms for women.
q.why: 原文说这样的房间一共有十二间。

q.s: Ada's work bag is near the exit.
q.why: 原文说她的工作包就在出口旁边。
